title: Track
body:
Syntax: perform track <mob or player name>

Normal Track (level 30) tracks the target automatically inside their area. Advanced Tracking (level 20+) is a separate scroll-learned passive upgrade: once you READ a scroll inscribed with Advanced Tracking, the SAME perform track <target> command can search actual connected exits across area borders. It still obeys closed doors and cannot teleport or cross disconnected rooms. Tracks a mob or online player, moves one room per pulse, pauses in combat and resumes when combat ends. Upkeep remains 5 Chakra per pulse. Ordinary Track remains area-limited for those who have not learned Advanced Tracking.
